description: Source code implementing RMSprop optimizer options, state management, and step function in PyTorch's C++ backend.

classes.name: RMSpropOptions
classes.description: Class representing options for RMSprop optimizer, including learning rate, alpha, epsilon, weight decay, momentum, and centered flag.

classes.name: RMSpropParamState
classes.description: Class managing the state of individual parameters during RMSprop optimization, including step count, square average, momentum buffer, and gradient average.

classes.name: RMSprop
classes.description: Class implementing the RMSprop optimizer, including step update, save, and load functions.
